questions: Did your difficulty with balance or coordination begin suddenly?
Have you had any recent falls?
Do you feel spinning or severe dizziness when walking?
Have you noticed weakness or numbness on one side of your body?
Do you have difficulty coordinating your hands, such as reaching accurately or fastening buttons?
Has your speech become slurred or unusually slow?
Do you have double vision or difficulty controlling your eye movements?
Have you had a new or severe headache?
Do you have tremor, stiffness, or unusually slow movements?
Have you experienced loss of bladder control or a marked change in memory or thinking?
Have you recently had an infection, head injury, or exposure to toxins?
Do you drink alcohol heavily or regularly?
Have you started or increased any medication recently, including sedatives, anticonvulsants, or drugs for dizziness?
Has anyone in your family had a similar problem with balance or coordination?
